senses.gloss: adv. (עָמַד) standing, in a standing position.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 38b:25">Shebu. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>שבועה מ׳ וכ׳</he> an oath must be taken standing, but scholars may remain seated.
<cite ref="Berakhot 30a:2">Ber. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>רב חסדא אמר מ׳</he> Rab Ḥ. says (he who is walking on the road) must stand still (during prayer), opp. <he>מהלך</he>; Y. ib. II, beg. 4ᵃ.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 155:5">Sifré Deut. 155</cite> <he>אין שירות כשר אלא מ׳</he> no function is properly performed if the priest is not standing; a. fr.
